item.title: 'Calvin and Hobbes' Best Bully Quote Is Still Among the Wisest in Comic Strip History
item.description: In the comic strip Calvin and Hobbes , Calvin often defines his babysitter Rosalyn as his arch-nemesis. He regularly plots against her and tries to sabotage her relationship with her boyfriend. He even locked her out of the house once while she was babysitting him, which got him into big trouble with his parents.

item.title: 46 Years Later, the Most Influential Thriller of All Time Is Officially Free on YouTube
item.description: Over the years, corporations and filmmakers alike have eagerly sought to revisit the origins of horror classics (e.g., Bates Motel and Psycho , Welcome to Derry and IT , etc.) for modern audiences. It’s an easy way to find success when you already have an audience that loves the IP you’re reimagining

item.title: 58 Years Later, Captain Kirk's Best Star Trek Quote Is the Greatest Line in Sci-Fi History
item.description: Some lines of dialogue become so famous they stop belonging to the movies and TV shows that produced them. “May the Force be with you.” “I’ll be back.” “You're gonna need a bigger boat.” You don't need to know the context. The words have long since transcended their original context and permeated the pop culture zeitgeist.

item.title: 61 Years Later, Charlie Brown's Greatest Enemy Is Still an Undefeated 'Peanuts' Icon
item.description: Like many comics aimed at children, Charles Schulz's Peanuts doesn't have too many actual villains. It has a number of antagonists, such as Lucy Van Pelt , various other kids, or the impersonal cloud of failure that constantly hangs over Charlie Brown's head, but it's rare to see a genuinely malevolent force in Peanuts — with one exception.

item.title: 8 Must-Play JRPGs for People With Real-Life Schedules
item.description: It’s 9:15 on a Wednesday night. The dishes are done. You have about 45 minutes before bed, and you’re a JRPG fan (or you were, when you had more time). JRPGs tend to demand dozens of hours from players — and they can make it very difficult to pause, as some of them will interrupt you with a battle every few steps.

item.title: Star Trek Reboot Officially Teased as Crimson Tide Meets Training Day Sci-Fi Thriller
item.description: After more than a decade of waiting, it seems we may finally get a new theatrically released Star Trek movie . While dedicated Trekkies have heard that before, the directors of the only known Star Trek movie in development recently shared details about their project. The pair helming the new Trek film , Jonathan Goldstein and John Francis Daley, broke down the movie's influences in an interview with Inverse .

item.title: Star Wars' New Jedi Order Era is Officially Moving Forward
item.description: Despite Star Wars: The Mandalorian & Grogu struggling at the box office, it seems Disney is continuing development on two upcoming Star Wars films. This summer, Star Wars: New Jedi Order and Dave Filoni’s untitled movie as in-development projects were confirmed to be in the works in industry publication Production Weekly, suggesting that despite delays and silence around the projects, they haven't been shelved.

item.title: GTA 6 Players Are Obsessed With Finding IRL Florida in Vice City
item.description: Now that Grand Theft Auto 6 is in the wild, one thing has become clear: The open-world crime stuff is secondary. This thing's a life sim . GTA 6 's life sim bona fides are so undeniable that, within the first two days of its release, a not-insignificant swath of players have eschewed the elaborate robberies and high-tension shootouts to instead embrace the ancient gaming tradition of "finding IRL locations and Leo memeing at them."

item.title: Where to find the giant crab safe code and Crabshack VF5 SMG in GTA 6
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 has a giant crab haunting the swamps and, more importantly, the Crabshack VF5 SMG , a crab-themed gun, to help your future career prospects. It's all part of an optional event called Pelican Valley Outpost that sees you pick up the pieces of some questionable experiments carried out on behalf of a store chain. It's worth the trouble, even aside from the standout weapon. There's some cash to help reach your next family fund milestone and a free jet ski, too. Best of all, this little excursion is completely safe, assuming you don't run afoul of the local gator population.
